Create an LDTrack object

Source: R/class_LDTrack.R
LDTrack.Rd

LDTrack() stores pairwise linkage disequilibrium results, retained variant metadata, the selected genomic region, and optionally the dosage matrix and the generated figure. It follows the same lightweight S3 list-class style used by VariantTrack and HapVariant.

Usage

LDTrack(
  data = NULL,
  matrix = NULL,
  variants = NULL,
  region = list(),
  genotype = NULL,
  figure = NULL,
  meta = list(),
  plot = NULL
)

Arguments

data

A data.frame/data.table of pairwise LD statistics.

matrix

A symmetric LD matrix. Diagonal values are usually 1.

variants

Variant metadata used in the calculation.

region

A list with chrom, start, and end.

genotype

Optional numeric genotype dosage matrix.

figure

Optional figure object produced by plot_ld_block().

meta

A metadata list.

plot

Deprecated alias for figure, kept only for compatibility with older development versions.

Value

An LDTrack object.
